about: Community plugins for RackTicker. Add yours with a pull request: one entry pointing at a public GitHub folder that contains plugin.json.

plugins.name: Departures
plugins.author: RackTicker
plugins.description: Live station boards: Amtrak across the United States, BART's colour-coded lines, and seven European stations, each drawn the way that country's boards look, with trains pulling into the platform.

plugins.name: Tanks
plugins.author: RackTicker
plugins.description: Real levels as sloshing water: California's big reservoirs, and the space station's urine and water tanks when NASA's live feed answers.

plugins.name: Quakes
plugins.author: RackTicker
plugins.description: Earthquakes around you from the USGS: a 24-hour seismograph drum, the latest shakes by size and distance, and a take-over when a strong one hits nearby.

plugins.name: Surf
plugins.author: RackTicker
plugins.description: The surf at your break: wave height, swell period and direction, water temperature, and the tide you can see — the sea sits high or low with it.

plugins.name: Now playing
plugins.author: RackTicker
plugins.description: The song you are listening to, like an old car stereo: album art, scrolling title and artist, track and time, and a segmented spectrum analyser. Spotify or any Home Assistant media player.
